name: Influence-gated Memory Write
mechanism: Routes user, retrieved, tool and model-derived observations into a quarantined candidate store and promotes only policy-compliant lineage-preserving memories after conflict and authority checks.
use_when: Retrieved evidence or tool output can become durable agent memory
Procedures or preferences can influence future actions
avoid_when: The system persists no cross-run memory
Candidate and canonical stores cannot be isolated
expected_effects: Reduced persistence of poisoned context across sessions
Auditable separation of observations from canonical memory
failure_modes: A summary hides malicious source instructions
Repeated low-risk candidates accumulate into high influence
Deletion misses derived memories and indexes
required_evals: deletion across source derived and indexed state
